description: This file defines the ConfigurationProvider class in the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically for client-side monitoring (CSM). It provides methods to create configuration providers from environment variables, INI files, or fallback defaults, and handles composing these providers into a chain. It also includes mechanisms for caching configurations and unwrapping configuration objects.

classes.name: ConfigurationProvider
classes.description: Provides methods to create configuration providers for AWS's client-side monitoring, including environment variable-based, file-based, and fallback configurations. Supports chaining providers and caching configurations.

methods.name: defaultProvider
methods.description: Creates a default CSM configuration provider that checks environment variables, config files, and fallback options, with optional caching.

methods.name: env
methods.description: Creates a configuration provider based on environment variables for CSM settings.

methods.name: fallback
methods.description: Provides fallback default configuration options when other sources are unavailable.

methods.name: ini
methods.description: Creates a configuration provider from a specified INI configuration file, with optional profile and filename parameters.

methods.name: unwrap
methods.description: Converts various forms of configuration inputs into a ConfigurationInterface object, handling callables, promises, and arrays.
